summary: This topic describes how to customize PDF templates by modifying their code and using specific variables to dynamically display data from the ERP system. It covers basic code changes and understanding common variable structures.
steps: Load an existing template or select a default one.
Modify the template's code (e.g., HTML, CSS) to change its appearance or content.
To display dynamic data, use variables with the 'DisplayData.' prefix.
Apply styling (e.g., 'uppercase' for text) directly in the code using CSS (e.g., 'text-transform: uppercase;').
business_rules: Most default templates require minor code changes to fit specific requirements.
Variables must be correctly spelled and prefixed with 'DisplayData.' to fetch data.
important_notes: Common variables include: DisplayData.EntityName (Institute name), DisplayData.EntityAddress (Institute address), DisplayData.EntityState (Institute state), DisplayData.EntityCountry (Institute country), DisplayData.EntityPinCode (Institute pin code), DisplayData.StudentName (Student's name), DisplayData.FatherName (Student's father's name), DisplayData.Gender (Student's gender), DisplayData.logo (Institute logo), DisplayData.session (Academic session).
Report cards often use default templates for basic schools, but advanced schools may require custom changes.
